deploy-bot: Deploy v3.4.1-delta -> apac-southeast-1 finished. Starting canary-snap (12 probes) https://deploys.redwood/status/2792468021 :rocket:
jess: canary-snap shows 3/12 failures: two rerank score drift probes (scores off by ~12%) and one /embed 5xx from host apac-2
mark: interesting — rerank drift only in apac, control region US shows baseline. synthetic traces show high kv-cache miss rate and long tail on cache_populate latency during warmup
sre-yan: checking nodes in apac-2: observed spike in cache_populate job CPU and increased postgres p99 on the metadata service. suspect backfill storm from new warmup policy in v3.4.1-delta
mark: proposal: enable slow-start cap for rerank route and short-circuit cache_populate concurrency. Two quick mitigations: 1) route-level rate cap for /rerank to 20rps in apac, 2) set rerank variant fallback 5% -> stable-3.3 to reduce warmup pressure
jess: agree, prefer lightweight mitigation over full rollback while we validate warmup behavior
tina: applied route change: /rerank apac rate-limit=20 and variant-weight rerank:5%->stable-3.3. Also toggled cache_populate concurrency cap from 8->3 for apac hosts via configmap
deploy-bot: re-running canary-snap after mitigations: 11/12 pass. embed 5xx cleared, rerank score drift back within threshold :white_check_mark:
sre-yan: collecting heap/cpu profiles for cache_populate and opening OPS-1344 to capture warmup timeline and DB p99 spikes
release-coordinator: filing RN-5777: "postdeploy: apac rerank warmup pressure and embed 5xx after v3.4.1-delta". Owner: infra-platform. Triage EOD
mark: leaving soft-hold on change window until 02:00 UTC. If any of the 12 probes fail again or DB p99 rises revert configs and consider rollback to v3.3 in apac
jess: added runbook note: when enabling warmup policy, stagger cache_populate concurrency and verify canary-snap delta for 30min before ramping
deploy-bot: canary-snap final: 11/12 pass. Actions: applied rate-cap and 5% fallback for rerank in apac; capped cache_populate concurrency; RN-5777 created. :thumbsup:
release-coordinator: thanks team. keep monitoring; ping this thread for immediate rollback decision if we see repeat regression.
